premises: Cr coatings improve oxidation resistance of Zr-alloy cladding in high-temperature steam
A compact, uniform Cr2O3 film forms on the Cr coating and reduces oxygen diffusion
Columnar grain boundaries in Cr coatings provide fast diffusion paths for oxygen
A relatively random grain orientation in the Cr coating yields a more compact, uniform oxide and better oxidation resistance than a strongly textured coating
